items.title: Santo Pecora Interview, 1972-11-09
items.q: Rosie used to make mouthpieces for me... And did you work with Rosie McCarr over there? Yeah.

ctx.x: Rosie was in the band? Rosie used to make mouthpieces for me. Oh, yeah? Yeah, crumbling, trumpet and... I didn't know he did that.
I know he arranged. Who were some of the good arrangers that you worked with? Worked with me?
